audit.whatIsWrong: The page states three times that Smoke Screen blinds you and makes your autos miss ('W blind', 'your Q autos miss and your sustain is cut in half'). Smoke Screen does not blind — it creates a cloud that reduces sight range and slows on impact. Your autos land normally; what you lose is vision of him. It also called the ability 'Smoke Canister', which is not its name. Quickdraw's real effect — double True Grit stacks when he dashes toward a champion, and a cooldown reduced by his autos — was never stated.
audit.why: Graves W: 'creating a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly.' Graves E: 'If Graves dashes towards an enemy champion, gain two stacks of True Grit instead. Hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown', 16/15/14/13/12.
audit.corrected: Nearsight-and-slow replaces the blind claim in whys[1], wants.foe[0], wants.you[1] and the early block; the fabricated 'Smoke Canister' removed; True Grit and the 16s Quickdraw cooldown stated in report[5].t and dosFull[0].d.

audit.corrected: All seven rows brought to that shape in matched full/content pairs, ratings re-spread 6/5/4/4/4/3/3.

edits.after: His kit is live too — Quickdraw makes your E-W whiff on a good read, so he owns the lane footprint from here.

edits.after: His first item outpaces your Q sustain — take the fight before it lands, on a spent E.

edits.before: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Track Graves's Quickdraw: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Fury W-stun + dash out.

edits.before: Keep you blinded with W smoke so your Q autos miss and your sustain is cut in half
edits.after: Drop Smoke Screen on you so you lose sight of him and the slow buys his Quickdraw exit

edits.before: Use Fury-empowered W at Level 2 to stun-trade before his smoke blinds your Q autos
edits.after: Use Fury-empowered W at Level 2 to stun-trade before Smoke Screen's slow buys his exit

edits.before: Level 1 you have no dash and Graves can already poke with his short-range shotgun autos, so respect the range gap and last-hit with Q tip rather than walking into his burst pattern. At Level 2 you get your first real window: E through him, W-stun immediately before he can E away, then Q-heal to recover his auto damage — this is your best early kill threat and you should force it with 50+ Fury stocked if possible. The key threat in this window is his W smoke: if he drops Smoke Canister before your W lands, your Q autos miss and your healing collapses, so commit the W first and save Q for the stun aftermath.
edits.after: Level 1 you have no dash and Graves can already poke with his short-range shotgun autos, so respect the range gap and last-hit at Q tip rather than walking into his burst pattern. At Level 2 you get your first real window: E through him, W-stun immediately before he can Quickdraw away, then Q-heal to recover his auto damage — this is your best early kill threat and you should force it with 50+ Fury stocked if possible. The threat in that window is Smoke Screen: it nearsights you and slows on impact, so he simply disappears from view and walks out — commit W first, then Q.

notes: The blind claim was the biggest error on this page and it appeared four times; Smoke Screen nearsights and slows, so the old advice ('your autos miss, your sustain collapses') would have had players disengage from trades they still win. Chart proposed as one atomic group matching the mirror. The mirror flagged that diff 'EVEN' at 5.5/10 sits oddly against a chart that is enemy-favoured from level 3; the same tension exists here (diff 'EVEN', 6/10) and I left it for the user rather than guess a tone hex.
